blocks.text: Freelancing and remote work allow individuals to offer their skills and services to clients through online platforms. Freelancers can work in areas such as graphic design, writing, programming, and digital marketing. Remote work enables people to work for companies from home or any location with an internet connection. These opportunities help students and professionals earn income independently. They are an important part of digital entrepreneurship as they provide flexibility and global access to job markets.
